docs.title: Acme Corp Q2 results
docs.text: Acme Corp reported second quarter revenue of 1.2 billion dollars, up 8 percent from a year earlier. Operating margin expanded to 22 percent as cloud services grew faster than the legacy hardware segment. The company raised its full year guidance and announced a 500 million dollar share buyback. Management said demand for its analytics platform remained strong across enterprise customers.
